title: Million Dollar Quartet
summary: Rockabiliy bridges Country swing, Gospel, and Rock and Roll. No album better illustrates the connection to Gospel than the "Million Dollar Quartert" The album, an accidental recording when Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins, Jerry Lewis, and Johnny Cash hung out in a studio in Memphis, Tenessee
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VX5-wHkhRFE&list=PLLyNewN1PuxhS4GsbbOp1sMtFuaKXvh6A

Rockabiliy bridges Country swing, Gospel, and Rock and Roll. No album better illustrates the connection to Gospel than the "Million Dollar Quartert"

The album, an accidental recording when Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins, Jerry Lewis,  and Johnny Cash hung out in a studio in Memphis, Tenessee
